reason: The inventory cannot drop working-tree deletions without either a stat per tracked path or an extra git listing (ls-files --deleted / --stage). Any git-based fix changes the ls-files argv that scripts/test_source_map_check.py::SourceMapCheckTest::test_main_synchronizes_snapshot_before_validation pins exactly (git_run.assert_called_once with the literal argument list). Satisfying the proof therefore retires an existing test's expectation, which the obligation does not declare under supersedes_tests. Implementer is not allowed to retire an undeclared test; the auditor should declare the supersession (authority G-01) or drop the finding.
